reponse:
Martin flagged two problems. Both were picked up, but only one is fixed.

1. **Webhook signatures failing on sandbox: fixed.** Ellen's team couldn't verify the signatures on payout.paid and seller.verified events (only about 1 in 20 verified), so they had turned verification off on sandbox [1]. Jake took it on the call [1]. He found that our worker was changing the message after signing it, so what Tradewell received no longer matched the signature [2]. The fix went to sandbox on Nov 16 [3] (PR core#1187 [2]). On Nov 17 Ellen turned verification back on and said all 300+ events since then verify [3].

2. **Different payout schedules per seller: not making Dec 7.** About 200 of Tradewell's top sellers are paid within 7 days (net-7) and everyone else within 30 (net-30). Today we only allow one schedule for the whole platform, and Martin said that would downgrade their best sellers on day one [1]. Owen took it back to product and engineering [1] and told Martin he'd have a clear answer by Friday Nov 20 [3]. Sofia opened QPAY-2362, and Tomer estimated 3–4 weeks [4]. On Nov 16 Avi ruled it out for Dec 7: he doesn't want to change how payouts are grouped this close to the contractual go-live. He moved it to Q1 2027, with late January at the earliest, and asked Owen to tell Martin [4].

**Martin hasn't been told yet.** On Nov 17 he asked Owen for an update because he needs it for his seller comms [3]. I don't see a reply from Owen in the channel [3]. He should probably pass on Avi's decision before Friday.
